integration.authority: Root SDKWork specs remain authoritative. Local specs may extend but must not contradict them.
integration.dependencyPolicy: This package is the Claw Router admin adapter for sdkwork-commerce-pc-admin-product and must consume the Commerce package through public package exports only.
integration.sdkPolicy: Product center SDK calls are owned by the Commerce admin product package and its Commerce service facade; this adapter must not add raw HTTP, manual auth headers, or local SDK forks.
integration.languagePolicy: Language-specific packages follow their native manifest and build tools while preserving the same component contract.
